Definition: from G2596 and G1725; directly opposite:--before, over against.
BiblicalUsage: To be directly opposite is to stand before, and Abraham believed God who quickens the dead and calls things that are not as though they were, and Paul says we speak before God in Christ, and again he writes that they speak before God in Christ for the Corinthians' edifying. The word is the place of standing before God, where nothing is hidden and everything is weighed.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe standing before God is the most serious place in the world, and the most comforting, because the God before whom I stand is the God who quickens the dead. I hold that I will speak as before God or not speak at all, because His presence is the only audience that matters.
